value.rationale: Exact conditional negative dependence unifies a motivated family of monotone empirical-CDF diagnostics and yields a sharp strict result for two standard distribution-free tests, runs and empirical one-Wasserstein. The result remains valid for every atomless common parent with integrable first moment; its conditional-on-pool form gives stronger interpretation than an isolated covariance or routine marginal calculation.
